description: Each fixture names the definition of collections.schema.json it is checked against and whether it is valid. The Host reads every answer fixture as it reads an answer of a Plugin declaring collections r3, host_operations r2 and namespaces r1: it accepts the valid ones and refuses the invalid ones as protocol violations, its page rules included. level1 says whether Level 1's own published schemas accept (true) or refuse (false) the same value.
